name: Thor (Ragnarok)

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Endurance: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki yeni hasarsız debuff'ların süresini azaltır.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Renewed Spark
Each Shock Debuff on the Opponent causes them to suffer 25% reduced Defensive Ability Accuracy, up to a 150% reduction.
When Thor's Combo Shield Passive is removed, it goes on cooldown for [30 - 10] seconds, and then returns.
immunityDetails:
• Şok Bağışıklığı ⚡️
• Güç Söndürme (Fade) Bağışıklığı 🔋🔽
• Arındırma (hasar vermeyen etkiler, ile sinerji: Quicksilver) 💪🏼

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Thor is Immune to Shock and Wither effects, and his Ability Power Rate cannot be increased above 100%.
Making contact with the Opponent while Thor has a personal Fury active has a 50% chance per personal Fury to inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [7,508.8] Energy Damage over 8 seconds.
When Thor inflicts a Shock, or when one is prevented by an Opponent's Immunity, he also inflicts an Armor Break Debuff, reducing the Opponent's Armor Rating by [305.56] for 8 seconds. Max stacks: 5.
When striking an Armor Broken Opponent, Thor has a 16% chance to deal a burst of [11,263.2] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Glorious Combatant
content: Thor begins each fight with a Combo Shield Passive for 2.5 seconds, which is paused until he is struck. As a Defender, this Combo Shield is indefinite.
Thor's Basic Attacks each grant him +1 additional Combo Meter.
Interrupting the Opponent's attacks grants Thor an additional +2 Combo Meter.
When struck with a Basic Attack by an Opponent that does not have a Prowess effect, Thor gains +5 Combo Meter.
Dashing forwards grants a non-stacking 50% Endurance Passive for 6 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.
When Thor would be Intercepted, he has a 30% chance to Auto-Block the attack. This Auto-Block is considered a Well-Timed Block.

abilitySections.title: Boon of the Gods
content: When Thor reaches 100 hits in his Combo Meter, he activates his Boon of the Gods Power Gain Passive, and then rapidly consumes 100 Combo over 3.6 seconds.
Thor's Power Gain fills his Power Meter over 6 seconds. It is not affected by Ability Accuracy and is removed when he is struck by a Special Attack. Max stacks: 1.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Fearsome Fighter
content: Each of the 3 hits grant Thor +6 additional Combo Meter.
If the Opponent is suffering from an Armor Break effect, the final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 1.8 seconds and deals a burst of [11,263.2] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - The Warrior Within
content: The first hit grants a non-stacking +[4,693] Fury Passive for 8 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - God of Thunder
content: Gain a non-stacking +[9,386] Fury Passive for 30 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
Inflict 4 Shock Debuffs, each dealing [4,693] Energy Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Renewed Spark
content: Each Shock Debuff on the Opponent causes them to suffer 25% reduced Defensive Ability Accuracy, up to a 150% reduction.
When Thor's Combo Shield Passive is removed, it goes on cooldown for [30 - 10] seconds, and then returns.
